mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. We have 76 degrees outside with clear skies near the Verona Public Library and a waning crescent moon overhead.

Construction updates continue as phase two of the Aldi development begins the week of September 7, which will shift traffic on Highway M. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is underway, with trail closures between Lincoln and South Franklin Street coming in mid-September.
There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness and a variety of trivia nights starting on Monday.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Friday, September 4, they arrested a 34-year-old Madison resident following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019.
You can enjoy today's flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry, at Culver's, which is currently open until 10:00 PM.
